text: Finland and Norway secretly sought to avert a military confrontation with Russia in the Baltic Sea. Finnish President Alexander Stubb and Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre used a Russian oligarch as an intermediary before speaking directly with Putin on October 27, reassuring him that NATO had no intention of imposing a naval blockade. Moscow had previously warned NATO it was prepared to launch preemptive nuclear strikes to defend its Baltic interests. Russia ships more than 60% of its seaborne oil through the Baltic, where tensions have escalated over Western efforts to intercept Russian shadow-fleet tankers. Source: WSJ
